name: Steph Routh

bio.statement: An OPB 2024 Portland City Council District 1 candidate profile lists Routh's occupation as small business owner and PSU adjunct instructor.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small business owner; Adjunct instructor, PSU

verification.note: Verified; OPB article dated 2024-09-26 (Portland City Council D1 profile). Same person confirmed: OPB text cites first executive director of Oregon Walks and Planning Commission service, matching her 2026 EMSWCD campaign site. Statement is dated 2024.

positions.statement: In a 2024 OPB candidate profile for Portland City Council, Routh says time and uncertainty in housing development are solvable problems.
positions.excerpt: Time and uncertainty are two expensive aspects of housing development, and these are solvable problems.

verification.note: Re-fetched 2026-10-15; excerpt present verbatim; attribution, tier and neutral wording confirmed.

positions.statement: In the same 2024 OPB profile, Routh says Portland needs to fix its roads.
positions.excerpt: We need to fix the damn roads.

verification.note: Re-fetched 2026-10-15; excerpt present verbatim; attribution, tier and neutral wording confirmed.

positions.statement: In the 2024 OPB profile, Routh opposes putting Portland's Clean Energy Fund back on the ballot.
positions.excerpt: I do not support putting the Clean Energy Fund back on the ballot.

verification.note: Re-fetched 2026-10-15; excerpt present verbatim; attribution, tier and neutral wording confirmed.
